# Third-party libraries

Local copies used by this webpage:

- Vega 5.33.0 — https://github.com/vega/vega — BSD-3-Clause, `vega-LICENSE.txt`.
- Vega-Lite 5.23.0 — https://github.com/vega/vega-lite — BSD-3-Clause, `vega-lite-LICENSE.txt`.
- Vega-Embed 6.29.0 — https://github.com/vega/vega-embed — BSD-3-Clause, `vega-embed-LICENSE.txt`.

Bundles were downloaded from jsDelivr's version-pinned npm package paths. They are included locally to avoid depending on a CDN during marking. License and copyright notices are retained in the accompanying files.

Natural Earth state/province geometry is public domain. See the webpage footer and `data/sources.json` for its URL and the attribution for QILT and ABS statistical material.
